verdict.rationale: Working Copy ships its own on-device Repository Agent, an AI assistant that can browse, search, read and modify repository files from the phone, so AI-driven code suggestions are plausible within the app. However, nothing documents the agent analyzing pull requests or producing review-style improvement suggestions. The other AI feature only suggests commit messages from staged diffs. missing for 10: documented AI analysis of pull requests, explicit code-review or improvement-suggestion workflow, hands-on or independent corroboration of agent quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent analyze my pull requests and suggest code improvements from my phone

citations.quote: Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.
Code Agent & commit suggestions. Respects your data with opt-in.
